D: A shy, bullied teenager with telekinetic powers is asked to the senior prom.
P: Serve the punch when Carrie and Tommy are crowned at the prom.
S: the senior prom at the high school
Devilled eggs with paprika, leg ham and pineapple chunks on toothpicks, and cucumber rounds piped with cream cheese and chives, on silver trays like a 1970s prom.
the girls' gym class at the start
Soft pretzels warmed at 200C for 5 minutes, brushed with melted butter, scattered with coarse salt, served with a honey mustard of Dijon, honey and a little mayo.
Radishes cut into roses, cucumber and carrot batons bunched like a corsage, with a ranch dip of buttermilk, sour cream, garlic, dill and chives.
M: Chicken breasts browned in butter, finished in a 200C oven, served with a creamy mushroom and white wine sauce, mashed potato and buttered green beans.
Carrie's strict mother and her bare kitchen table
A plain beef stew done well: chuck browned, onion and carrot softened, stock and bay, braised 3 hours at 160C, potatoes in for the last hour, with buttered white bread.
W: Two vanilla sponges baked at 175C, layered with sliced strawberries and whipped cream, covered in pale pink strawberry buttercream, a little sugar crown on top.
K: the punch bowl in the gym
Pineapple juice and lemonade with sliced strawberries and orange in a big glass bowl, a ring of frozen juice floating instead of ice so it doesn't water down.

s.note: the senior prom at the high school
s.how: Boil 6 eggs, halve and pipe with yolks whipped with mayo and paprika. Thread 150g diced ham and a quarter pineapple onto toothpicks. Pipe 150g cream cheese with chives onto cucumber rounds. Serve on silver trays.
Cut radishes into roses and bunch cucumber and carrot batons like a corsage. Mix 100ml buttermilk, 150g sour cream, a crushed garlic clove, dill and chives for ranch.

m.how: Brown 4 chicken breasts in butter and finish in a 200C oven. Fry 250g mushrooms in the pan, add 150ml white wine and 150ml cream and reduce. Mash 1kg potatoes. Steam 300g green beans and toss with butter.

w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Fill with 250g sliced strawberries and 200ml whipped cream. Cover in pink buttercream of 150g butter, 300g icing sugar and mashed strawberry.

d.note: the punch bowl in the gym
d.how: Freeze 500ml pineapple juice in a ring tin overnight. Put it in a big glass bowl and pour over 1.25L lemonade and 250ml more pineapple juice. Add sliced strawberries and orange.
